description: This is a shell script that defines a series of tests for conversion filters applied within a git repository, focusing on large files and various encoding and line-ending conversions.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets attributes for conversion filters and writes configuration to .gitattributes

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Verifies input conversion filters on git object trees

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Verifies output conversion filters by checking checked-out files
